name: cc-ai-dev
description: Requirement-to-code workflow skills: interview-driven specifications, traceable development plans, plan-driven implementation, plan-less direct implementation, workflow runs under a user-confirmed skill selection, root-cause bug diagnosis, design-driven code writing, evidence-driven refactoring, unattended goal-driven iteration loops, CLAUDE.md synchronisation with the shared upstream template, and age-gated, SHA-pinned GitHub Actions upgrades. All skills except upgrade-gh-wf-actions load on explicit invocation only (/cc-ai-dev:<skill> in Claude Code, /<skill> in Copilot, or the skill name in the prompt); upgrade-gh-wf-actions also activates on requests to upgrade or pin GitHub Actions.
